summary: Implemented the active-illumination trio for orbit render workflows. The checked-in orbit light settings now define scene_on_flashlight_off, scene_off_flashlight_on, and scene_on_flashlight_on, and render mode splits settings into scene-on and scene-off passes so scene-off uses disabled scene lights independent of the configured scene-on scale.
work_completed: Updated examples/flashlight/orbit_light_settings.json to contain exactly the three requested default conditions: scene_on_flashlight_off, scene_off_flashlight_on, and scene_on_flashlight_on.

Extended examples/flashlight/run_orbit_collection.py light-setting validation with optional scene_lights_enabled and grouped render execution by scene-light state; scene-off groups set disable_scene_lights=True and reset scene_light_intensity_scale to 1.0 for that pass.
Preserved legacy/custom light-setting behavior: entries without scene_lights_enabled default to scene-on behavior.

Updated examples/flashlight/run_orbit_workflow.sh help text to make the default render trio explicit while preserving teleop/default argument wiring and fixed --disable-auto-exposure render invocation.
Updated examples/flashlight/README.md and docs/running_our_example_applications.md with the three-condition render contract, scene-on scale behavior, scene-off independence, and output video paths.
Added lightweight tests for scene_lights_enabled validation, render grouping, scene-off argument isolation, and checked-in JSON names/flags.
